تعتادوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَادُوا (taʕtādū) /taʕ.taː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
# تُعْتَادُوا (tuʕtādū) /tuʕ.taː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
